title: Unify customer shipping money across PrepShip and Client Portal and reconcile exact historical return receipts

acceptanceCriteria.description: PrepShip owns one policy-versioned purchased-cost, customer-rate, and margin tuple; Billing, return read models, and Client Portal delegate instead of deriving alternate truth.
New Client Portal returns persist the exact provider-selected label cost before invoking the scoped PrepShip freeze boundary, while missing or partial legacy facts fail closed.
The customer-shipping-money endpoint enforces client/store scope and permission and does not disclose internal purchased-cost or margin fields in its response.

Exactly two historical real return receipts were repaired from matching persisted provider evidence to the canonical frozen tuple; three explicit offline zero-cost test rows remained unchanged and the post-audit delta is zero.
The historical repair found no Billing line, invoice, or finalized period and changed no Billing history, status, label, postage, provider, marketplace, print, or inventory fact.

Strict typecheck, production web build, focused PS-437 checks, rate and billing behavioral boundaries, shipped/return lockdown checks, and the complete source-of-truth pack pass; both applications are live and ready on their target branches.

sotBypass.details: Neither React nor Client Portal owns authoritative shipping-money policy. The reconciliation cannot estimate a cost or call a provider; it accepts only two fixed rows whose durable label receipt components agree and asks the canonical PrepShip policy owner for the frozen tuple.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-437-customer-shipping-money && npm run test:return-order-summary && npm run test:order-editable-lockdown
evidence.proves: Policy thresholds, complete tuple parsing, fail-closed missing cost, scoped endpoint placement, thin return display consumption, reconciliation safety flags, and shipped/cancelled mutation locks remain present.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-433-rate-boundary with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: The real backend rate/proof boundary integrates with an injected provider seam and rejects mismatched order, account, and rate facts before provider activity.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-433-rate-boundary with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: Cross-order, cross-account, and stale/mismatched selected-rate facts fail before the provider spy is touched.
The Billing source of truth preserves line cardinality and stable totals across repeated reads of a current PostgreSQL-compatible fixture.
Cancelled/return, duplicate, out-of-window, and cross-client fixtures cannot corrupt authoritative Billing cardinality or totals.

The default transaction rolled back after exactly two fixed candidates passed receipt agreement, active-return, client, no-snapshot, no-Billing, and canonical-policy guards; the script has no provider-capable import or generic scan/update path.

evidence.command: Rollback-only preflight; npx tsx scripts/ps-437-reconcile-return-money.ts --apply --confirm-production --expected-count=2; then npx tsx scripts/ps-437-return-money-audit.ts
evidence.proves: Production now has two exact policy-versioned frozen return tuples at zero canonical delta and three unchanged offline no-charge fixtures, with zero Billing/provider/label/postage/marketplace/print/inventory side effect.

evidence.command: Client Portal GitHub Actions CI run 29548396218 and DB-backed integration run 29548396231
evidence.proves: Client Portal main passes its compile/test pipeline and DB-backed return integration after the exact-cost persistence and PrepShip freeze delegation change.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript checks pass with the audit and reconciliation tooling.
The production PrepShip web bundle builds successfully with 2,977 modules transformed.

evidence.command: npm run test:sot-guard-pack with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: The complete mandatory source-of-truth, rate, label, Billing, lifecycle, lockdown, and runtime-schema guard pack passes.

The reviewed PrepShip commits contain the canonical policy/snapshot boundary, thin scoped route and consumers, bounded historical tool, tests, and report; no migration or destructive schema change exists.

verification.command: No migrations were added or modified; not applicable.

migrations.rollbackPlan: Revert the PS-437 application commits to remove runtime behavior. Do not blindly reverse the two historical frozen money facts; if policy truth is later disproved, use a separately reviewed, exact-evidence correction that preserves Billing-finalization rules.

rollback.strategy: Revert the PrepShip PS-437 implementation/report commits and the three Client Portal PS-437 commits. Production historical tuples are already canonical evidence-backed facts and require a separate reviewed correction rather than a destructive rollback.

liveVerification.reason: Both target applications are live/ready, and the post-apply production audit proves the exact two frozen tuples, three unchanged offline fixtures, zero canonical delta, and no Billing history or external side effect.
